content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "KC-46A MDAP (budget line KC046A) is a U.S. Air Force procurement program, a Major Defense Acquisition Program funded in the Aircraft Procurement, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "f39c89b9cf5d60fb"}}, {"text": "The KC-46 is a commercial-derivative aerial-refueling tanker that also serves as a key joint and coalition communications node, providing fuel to receivers via boom or drogue and augmenting the airlift fleet with cargo, passenger, and aeromedical-evacuation capabilities.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d8eefce7b81b6518"}}, {"text": "The aircraft is validated by the Joint Requirements Oversight Council multiple times from November 2004 to April 2024 and is described as a critical force extender in the Joint Warfighting Concept, able to operate day and night and in adverse weather in up to medium-threat environments with self-defense capabilities.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d8eefce7b81b6518"}}, {"text": "The KC-46 replaces the legacy tanker fleet in stages, with the initial increment replacing roughly a third of current capability; following an Analysis of Alternatives completed in April 2006, the Air Force chose full-and-open competition for a commercial-derivative replacement tanker.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ee44a617cd526d56"}}, {"text": "The Milestone B decision was reached on 23 February 2011 and the Engineering and Manufacturing Development contract was awarded to Boeing on 24 February 2011 to develop and procure 179 KC-46 aircraft; with a subsequent program-of-record increase, the program plans to procure 183 aircraft across 13 lots.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ee44a617cd526d56"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 budget supports procurement of 15 KC-46A aircraft (Lot 12) along with associated support equipment, operational site activation, depot stand-up, Interim Contractor Support, and government-furnished equipment for Lot 13 production.", "citation": {"fact_id": "98145a81e36e694e"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's main FY2026 procurement line requests $2,799,633 thousand (about $2.80 billion) in Aircraft Procurement, Air Force, all discretionary funding.", "citation": {"fact_id": "fdd617708bac125d"}}, {"text": "That main line was enacted at $2,779,618 thousand (about $2.78 billion) in FY2025, so the FY2026 request is only modestly higher.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a68dd07fdd2c7a8f"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $2,783,927 thousand (about $2.78 billion), keeping the FY2026 request close to its recent execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "f39c89b9cf5d60fb"}}, {"text": "A separate, much smaller advance-procurement line requests $19,344 thousand (about $19.3 million) of discretionary funding in FY2026, down from $24,954 thousand enacted in FY2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "51f86b2ca16a1e98"}}, {"text": "Beyond the aircraft themselves, FY2026 funding covers continued production of low-technical-risk parts of the corrected Boom Telescope Actuator kits — which take roughly 30 months to manufacture — to enable depot kit installs starting in FY2027 during regular C-checks.", "citation": {"fact_id": "98145a81e36e694e"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 request also funds a new start, the P-3A Mod 4602 Pegasus Advanced Communications Suite (PACS), procuring the initial 12 kits for that modification.", "citation": {"fact_id": "82dd00eeb122d82c"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Aircraft Procurement, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a4ebf32e5bd78cde"}}, {"text": "Boeing is the KC-46 developer and producer, having been awarded the Engineering and Manufacturing Development contract on 24 February 2011 to develop and procure the aircraft.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ee44a617cd526d56"}}, {"text": "Aircrew-training-device procurement supports throughput levels identified by Air Mobility Command, the operating command whose requirements shape the program's training support.", "citation": {"fact_id": "98145a81e36e694e"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
